result.rationale: The pagination logic added in this diff has an off-by-one: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1, so when user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g., 100 users, limit 50) it reports 3 pages when only 2 exist, and currentPage = Math.floor(offset/limit)+1 can then never equal totalPages, so showingLast never activates and the 'next' action remains enabled past the last page. The finding's exact attribution to currentPage is slightly imprecise (currentPage's formula alone is correct), but the described off-by-one defect in the new pagination code is real and verifiable from the diff.

record.issue_text: currentPage in admin-group.js.es6 has the same off-by-one rounding problem

adjudication.rationale: `currentPage` is computed as `Math.floor(offset/limit) + 1` (admin-group.js.es6). But the pagination actions allow `offset` to reach `user_count` (`next` sets `offset = Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`). When `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 100/50), `offset` can become 100, making `currentPage` = 3 even though there are only 2 pages. This is an off-by-one pagination bug exposed by the diff.
